# re-forge

> re-forge makes coding agents that evolve against a team's real work. It captures every session (every prompt, tool call, and outcome), recognises the workflows the team repeats, and keeps only the candidate agents that win on those tasks: Darwinian selection instead of a benchmark suite.

Site: https://theadaply.com/
Company: TheAdaply, https://github.com/TheAdaply
Contact and waitlist: https://tally.so/r/lb4Rkp

## Read before installing

- https://theadaply.com/FOR-AGENTS.md: how an assistant should audit re-forge before a human installs it
- https://theadaply.com/CAPTURE-MANIFEST.json: machine-readable declaration of what is captured, what is sent, and what is never sent

## Facts

- A human runs the installer after reading the consent screen. Nothing is captured before consent exists on disk.
- Kill switch: the file ~/.reforge/DISABLED stops capture immediately.
- Every number on the site carries a label: measured, detected, upper bound, or reused.
- Measured on the founders' own two-person team first (Jun 20 to Jul 2, 2026).
